details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:414-416 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `PROMPT_ROOT_DIR` is computed but never used after the temp-file location moved to `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`.
  WHY: The resolver call is dead code that adds an unnecessary filesystem walk on every render; all reviewers rated it NIT/low severity.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:273-278 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail` writes the parse-failure prefix only to stderr.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on whether this is intentional, but the highest stated severity was MAJOR/high because downstream log-analysis and JSONL consumers can miss `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL`.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:244 and 416 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap only runs on `EXIT`, so forceful termination can leave mktemp files behind.
  WHY: `kill -9`, OOM, or termination before clean exit can leak temp files; reviewers split between NIT and MAJOR, so consensus uses the highest severity.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:cleanup_temp_files function (no exact line because it is a function definition) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap is only re-armed on the identity-recall injection path, so a failed injection can leave a previously created temp file unreaped on re-entry in the same shell process.
  WHY: In a long-lived shell that sources `render_prompt.sh` repeatedly, an early return before trap setup can leak `/tmp` files.
- agents.md:448-454 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` tracer and `Identity recall:` guidance are split across two files, reducing discoverability.
  WHY: The documentation is not centralized, which reviewers said violates the single-source-of-truth pattern and hurts maintainability.
- prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt:22 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The added `4a. ## Decisions` requirement is outside the identity-recall scope.
  WHY: Reviewers treated it as scope creep / template-runtime drift; severity was NIT/low.
- tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh:around line 199-200 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The shared-prelude test does not verify the injected block is placed after the first non-comment paragraph when the source starts with comment lines.
  WHY: The Python extraction skips leading `#` and blank lines, so the block could be inserted after a comment header instead of the intended semantic paragraph; another reviewer marked this concern as a false positive.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add `tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh` to cover successful rendering across `prompts/mode-*.txt` and fail-open behavior for malformed prompts."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `test_shared_prelude_path_injects_and_cleans_temp_files` only exercises `mode-plan.txt` with `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true`, `test_flag_on_renders_or_fails_open_per_prompt_shape` does not enable `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED`, and the broader assembled-prelude matrix for other `mode-*.txt` prompts (clarify/plan/implement/validate/judge/orchestrate/etc.) is not validated.
- requirement: "Extend `agents.md` with the new fail-open prefix documentation for `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL`"
  expected_change_site: agents.md
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  EVIDENCE: `agents.md` adds `LOG_PREFIX.name=IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` in the manifest list and documents `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` in the shipped prefixes section, but the rule documentation remains split with `unattended_system_instructions.md` rather than centralized in `agents.md`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
(No findings reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:244 and 416 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap uses `trap cleanup_temp_files EXIT` which only runs on normal script exit. A `kill -9`, runner OOM, or SIGTERM leaves orphan temp files in `/tmp/`.
  WHY: Temp files created by mktemp (both `.identity.*` and `.assembled.*`) are never cleaned up if the process is forcefully terminated.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:414 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `PROMPT_ROOT_DIR="$(resolve_prompt_root_dir "${ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_FILE}")"` is computed but never used after the mktemp location moved to `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`.
  WHY: Unnecessary path resolution on every render, minor CPU overhead but dead code that misleads maintainers.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:273-278 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail` writes the parse-failure prefix only to stderr. The workflow log-analysis pipeline and `scripts/emit_event.sh` JSONL mirror expect either stdout or explicit mirror calls to capture events.
  WHY: Parse failures can be missed by retro analysis, memory-learning extraction, and the events JSONL stream. Operators monitoring `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` in workflow logs may not see failures that occur during render passes without proper mirroring.
- Requirement: "Add `tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh` to cover successful rendering across `prompts/mode-*.txt` and fail-open behavior for malformed prompts."
  Expected change site: tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh
  Evidence of absence: The test exists and passes, but `test_shared_prelude_path_injects_and_cleans_temp_files` only exercises `mode-plan.txt` with `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true`. It does not assert that every assembled prompt in the CI matrix (clarify/plan/implement/validate/judge/orchestrate/etc.) receives the identity-recall block when both flags are enabled.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:414-416 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `PROMPT_ROOT_DIR` is assigned but never used after the prior change moved mktemp location to `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`.
  WHY: The assignment and call to `resolve_prompt_root_dir` are dead code and add an unnecessary path resolution on every prompt render.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:line 137 (emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Fail-open parse-failure prefix is written only to stderr, so downstream logging/mirroring consumers (e.g., workflow log-analysis pipeline, JSONL mirror via emit_event.sh) never receive the event.
  WHY: Parse failures can be missed by retro analysis and memory-learning extraction pipelines that rely on captured stdout telemetry; the `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` prefix must be mirrored to logs that downstream tools sample.
- agents.md:448-454 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` tracer and the earlier `Identity recall:` guidance are split across two files, reducing discoverability and violating the single-source-of-truth pattern used by other prefixes.
  WHY: Reviewers, judges, and downstream tools rely on discovering logging prefixes in one centralized index; scattering the prefix doc and its contract guidance reduces maintainability and the likelihood of consistent usage.
- tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh:around line 199-200 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test exercises `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` with `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true`, but the `TemporaryDirectory` variant does not assert the injected block is placed after the first non-comment paragraph when the source has leading comment lines; the Python extraction skips `#` and blank lines prior to the paragraph, so it could place the block after a comment header instead of immediately after the role/goal paragraph.
  WHY: The rendered block would be produced but not at the intended semantic location, which could mislead downstream reviewers and reduce the intended identity recall value.
- Requirement: "Extend `agents.md` with the new fail-open prefix documentation for `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL`"
  Expected change site: `agents.md`
  Evidence of absence: The `agents.md` file adds `LOG_PREFIX.name=IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` in the manifest list and documents `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` in the shipped prefixes section, but the PR does not include the required **rule documentation** for this prefix (unlike other prefixes which have explanatory prose). The "fail-open prefix documentation" referenced in the requirement is satisfied by the list entry, but the contract is split across `agents.md` and `unattended_system_instructions.md` which reduces discoverability.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: "Add `tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh` to cover successful rendering across prompts/mode-*.txt and fail-open behavior for malformed prompts."
  Expected change site: `tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh`
  Evidence of absence: The test file exists and covers flag-off stability, flag-on injection, inline prompt mapping, and malformed-prompt fail-open. However, the consensus finding from pass-1 reviewers notes the test does not cover the combined `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` + `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true` path for assembled prompts from `_templates/` across the full CI matrix (clarify/plan/implement/validate/judge), which is a coverage gap for the integrated assembly+injection path.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:414 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Dead code - `PROMPT_ROOT_DIR` is computed but never consumed
  WHY: After the identity recall injection moved temp files to `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`, the `PROMPT_ROOT_DIR` assignment and its underlying `resolve_prompt_root_dir` call perform filesystem traversal that never affects program output, wasting cycles and misleading maintainers about the actual temp file location.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:lines 273-276 (`emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail` function) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Parse-failure telemetry only emits to stderr, missing downstream JSONL mirroring
  WHY: The `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` prefix is written exclusively to stderr (`>&2`). The workflow log-analysis pipeline and `scripts/emit_event.sh` JSONL event mirror expect structured output on stdout or explicit mirror calls; parse failures may be invisible to retrospective analysis and memory-learning extraction that only processes the event stream.
- prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt: line 22 (added `4a. ## Decisions` requirement) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Unrelated contract change bundled in Phase B PR
  WHY: The new `4a. ## Decisions` requirement changes the planning-mode output contract, which is outside the scope of Phase B (identity-recall injection). This creates template/runtime drift when the live `prompts/mode-plan.txt` and plan.yml already carry the `## Decisions` contract, but the template file change is not reverted.
- Requirement: "Extend `agents.md` with the new fail-open prefix documentation for `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL`"
  Expected change site: `agents.md`
  Evidence of absence: The `agents.md` file adds `LOG_PREFIX.name=IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL
